description: Runbook gate 4 happy path against the parity API serving the migrated dataset: /health 200; GET /api/stu/student?limit=2 -> 200 {"data":[...]} envelope; GET /api/feeTx?limit=2 -> 200 {"data":[...]} newest-first; POST /api/feeTx with the gate's demo body -> 201 Created with Location header, TXN-<utc-ms> txNo, and the fixed success message; the inserted row is then readable back through GET /api/feeTx.
notes: Response shapes, defaults, status-code mapping, and messages are lifted verbatim from the .NET sources (Program.cs, StudentQueries.cs, FeeTransactionQueries.cs, FeeTransactionWriteQueries.cs, FeeTransactionApiResponse.cs); gate commands and the demo POST body are lifted verbatim from agent_runbook.md Step 4 - nothing hand-invented. PII synthesized; the dataset referenced is the synthetic etl_module_students fixture (ids ending a1/b1/c1) plus a synthetic fee - the gate's demo UUIDs are captured verbatim but only resolve on the demo dataset (see spec open item 2/known_unstated). Nondeterministic values (ids, txNo, timestamps) asserted by rule. Capture against a live legacy run to set validated_against_legacy=true.

environment.services: rpg-postgres healthy, rpg-api running (gate 1 passed); Swagger UI at root

dataset.note: the migrated synthetic fixture: organization/institute/student ids 00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1/b1/c1 plus fee id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d1 named 'Test Fee One' with display_text

gate_commands.body_note: demo UUIDs captured verbatim from agent_runbook.md; they are NOT the synthetic fixture's ids - on the fixture dataset they dangle silently (no FK) and the gate still passes; see spec open items 2-3

assert_rules.timestamp: non-empty UTC datetime; do not assert literally

body_shape.data: array of student objects (length 1 on the fixture dataset; <= limit)

student_assert_rules.keys_camel_cased: all keys camelCase; special cases preserved: photoURL (URL uppercase), instId/studentId/courseId/virtualId (Id), dob/doa lowercase, pan lowercase
student_assert_rules.synthetic_defaults: domicile.country 'India' when source domicile absent; attendance 'Present' when source attendance lacks Status; attendanceList 8x'Present' when absent; doa '0001-01-01T00:00:00' when enrollment lacks DOA; rollNo 0 when no RollNo/RollNoAsInt
student_assert_rules.first_enrollment_only: courseName/termName/sectionName/rollNo come from enrollments[0] exclusively (LATERAL LIMIT 1) - fixture student has exactly one enrollment
student_assert_rules.parent_emails: parentEmails is a 3-element array [fatherEmail, motherEmail, guardianEmail] with '' for absent entries

body_shape.data: array, possibly empty on a fresh fixture (no migrated transactions); length <= limit

body_assert_rules.id: fresh UUID (Guid.NewGuid()); do not assert literally; equals the Location query id
body_assert_rules.txNo: matches ^TXN-\d{17}$ (TXN-<yyyyMMddHHmmssfff> UTC, millisecond precision); do not assert literally; NOTE no unique constraint -> same-ms collisions possible (spec open item)
body_assert_rules.txDate: UTC datetime close to capture time; do not assert literally
body_assert_rules.echoes: studentId and amount echo the request body verbatim

side_effects.row_persisted: fee_transaction row with id/tx_no/tx_date/student_id/amount/status='Active' (fee_tx_status_enum)/ref_no='AGENT-DEMO-01'/installments_paid=[{FeeId, Amount:500, DueDate:<now no fraction>}]
side_effects.dangling_reference_allowed: studentId/feeId need not exist in the dataset (no FK on student_id; feeId only embedded in JSONB) - see spec open item 2
side_effects.synthetic_installment: installments_paid is exactly ONE fabricated installment regardless of the fee's real plan (spec open item 5)
side_effects.audit_trigger: trg_fee_transaction_audit inserts a fee_transaction_audit row (NOT asserted by this curl gate; asserted by xUnit DbWriteTests in runbook gate 5)

body_assert_rules.newest_first: data[0] is the just-created row (ORDER BY tx_date DESC NULLS LAST, tx_no DESC)
body_assert_rules.echoed_fields: data[0].refNo 'AGENT-DEMO-01', amount 500.0, status 1 (Active->1), paidBy null (body omitted paidBy), txNo/txDate match the 201 body
body_assert_rules.enrichment_defaults: installmentsPaid[0].dueDate has fractional seconds stripped; feeAdjustment defaults to {id: empty-guid, name:'Adj Fee', description:'Extra Amount', amount:0} since the write forces fee_adjustment to {}
body_assert_rules.student_enrichment: studentName/courseId/courseName/section resolve from the matched student's first enrollment; on the demo UUID dataset these resolve to empty strings/null (student id dangles)

gate_verdict.criterion: all three curls exit 0 (curl -f: HTTP >= 400 would fail the gate); health 200 + reads 200 + write 201 satisfy the runbook gate-4 criteria
gate_verdict.caveat: the 'valid JSON array returned' criterion is satisfied only under the interpretation 'JSON containing an array' - literal bare-array check would fail (spec open item 1)

nondeterministic_fields: created transaction id / txNo / txDate (fresh GUID + UTC-ms timestamp per request)
order-independent reads: on multi-row datasets, GET limit=2 truncates to the 2 newest
known_unstated: the demo UUIDs in the POST body resolve only on the original demo dataset; on any other dataset they dangle silently and the gate still passes (reified in specs/migration/runbook-gates.md open item 3 and this spec's open item 2) - deliberately not encoded as a failing expectation
GET /api/fee is part of the API surface (README) but not part of the gate-4 curl contract; not exercised by this fixture
todaysAbsenteesOnly no-op behaviour is reified as an open item, not encoded here
